description: This file declares an interface for retrieving and handling stack backtraces in C programs. It includes function prototypes for initializing, dumping, capturing, resolving, and copying backtrace data, as well as related enums and macros. The header also contains documentation comments explaining usage notes for executable compilation options and post-mortem analysis tools.

methods.name: backtrace_init
methods.description: Initializes the backtrace subsystem, setting up necessary data structures or state.

methods.name: backtrace_dump
methods.description: Outputs the current backtrace information, typically for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: backtrace
methods.description: Captures the current call stack and applies the provided handler function to each frame.

methods.name: backtrace_copy
methods.description: Copies backtrace addresses into a buffer for further processing.

methods.name: backtrace_resolve
methods.description: Resolves a raw address to function and filename symbols for human-readable backtrace logs.

ctags.name: backtrace_func_t
ctags.pattern: /^typedef bool        backtrace_func_t(void *ctx, void *addr, const char *func, const char *object/
ctags.typeref: typename:bool ()(void * ctx,void * addr,const char * func,const char * object)
